exposure: High-level traction force (≥75th percentile) during the first three pulls of vacuum extraction
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 331 women undergoing low- and mid-vacuum extractions at the labor and delivery ward, Karolinska University Hospital, Huddinge, Sweden
finding: High-level traction force during vacuum extraction may be a risk factor for neonatal intensive care unit admission, but not for Apgar scores <7 at 5 minutes or pH <7.1.
